e.title: insurance-conformal
e.summary: 保形预测定价区间（burning-cost，MIT）：Tweedie/Poisson 模型的不确定性量化
e.body: insurance-conformal（burning-cost，PyPI，MIT）给 Tweedie/Poisson 保险模型做保形预测区间（conformal prediction intervals）：分布无关的预测不确定性量化。对 RIAA：定价预测的不确定性量化——「预测值 ± 区间」比单点预测更有决策价值（费率充足性/资本评估）；与 [[tweedie-python]]（分布定价）、[[insurance-distributional-glm]]（分布 GLM）配套：分布 + 区间双视角；保形预测是统计学习的新方法（无需分布假设）；定价/资本研究的进阶工具。
e.verified_note: 源码核实：burning-cost 仓库 + PyPI 确认（保形预测区间，MIT），未实测
e.summary_en: Conformal prediction intervals for pricing (burning-cost, MIT): distribution-free uncertainty quantification for Tweedie/Poisson models
e.summary_hk: 保形預測定價區間（burning-cost，MIT）：Tweedie/Poisson 模型的不確定性量化
e.body_en: insurance-conformal (burning-cost, PyPI, MIT) provides conformal prediction intervals for Tweedie/Poisson insurance models: distribution-free quantification of prediction uncertainty. For RIAA: uncertainty quantification for pricing predictions — 'prediction ± interval' has more decision value than point predictions (rate-adequacy/capital assessment); with [[tweedie-python]] (distributional pricing) and [[insurance-distributional-glm]] (distributional GLM) it forms the distribution + interval dual view; conformal prediction is a modern statistical-learning method (no distribution assumptions); an advanced tool for pricing/capital research.
e.body_hk: insurance-conformal（burning-cost，PyPI，MIT）給 Tweedie/Poisson 保險模型做保形預測區間（conformal prediction intervals）：分佈無關的預測不確定性量化。對 RIAA：定價預測的不確定性量化——「預測值 ± 區間」比單點預測更有決策價值（費率充足性/資本評估）；與 [[tweedie-python]]（分佈定價）、[[insurance-distributional-glm]]（分佈 GLM）配套：分佈 + 區間雙視角；保形預測是統計學習的新方法（無需分佈假設）；定價/資本研究的進階工具。
